Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at rpn: the pair (rpn, lzz) comes first; its second item is lzz, so the next pair is the one whose first item is lzz: (lzz, ddd). Its second item is ddd, but ddd never appears as a first item - so ddd is the dangling end of the chain.

ANSWER: rpn, lzz, ddd
